The top line has not reached the tail junction, and there is no upper fork yet. The picture shows no hand labels, so I still can't say who placed what. I'm not scoring anyone on attribution I can't verify.

Maya: Stayed in charge. At 2:15 she gave a clear plan: Priya keeps going, she jumps to the middle of the back and meets her in between. Jumping ahead and meeting in the middle is a sound way to speed things up. Her role is still the strongest evidence for leadership. The doubled stretch may be where the segments met, but I can't confirm it was her. Execution is unverified.

Tom: Silent again and not mentioned in any instruction. I don't know what he's building. The bottom line is long and clean, but I can't credit him for it. Ask him directly, and ask the team privately who built it.

Priya: Now apparently on the top line, per Leo and Maya, so she is included again. Still silent to me. Ask her privately about the overlap and how she feels about the changing roles.

Leo: Coordinating from the side. He gave clear direction at 2:30 (Priya to the junction, he takes the upper fork, he checks the bottom fork) but is waiting rather than building. Collaboration looks better than visit 1. Impact is not yet visible. He is the one who needs to deliver the upper fork and the tail.
